Command_CMD_START.description: Enqueue a new feature request onto a queue with optional pipeline, position, and start-intent overrides.

Command_CMD_CANCEL.description: Cancel a target task/run resolved explicitly by FeatureRequest.id.

Command_CMD_REMOVE_QUEUE_ITEM.description: Remove an item from a queue after explicit operator confirmation.

Command_CMD_RETRY_QUEUE_ITEM.description: Retry a failed or canceled queue item by id.

Command_CMD_MOVE_QUEUE_ITEM_UP.description: Move a pending queue item one position earlier.

Command_CMD_MOVE_QUEUE_ITEM_DOWN.description: Move a pending queue item one position later.

Command_CMD_PAUSE_QUEUE.description: Pause a queue with an optional operator-supplied reason.

Command_CMD_RESUME_QUEUE.description: Resume a paused queue (canonized to live validator allowlist: queueId only).

Command_CMD_START_QUEUE.description: Offer a queue a drain pass or apply an explicit start/schedule intent.

Command_CMD_CLEAR_COMPLETED.description: Clear completed items from the explicitly addressed queue.

Command_CMD_CLEAR_QUEUE.description: Queue-scoped Clean All addressing one explicit queueId.

Command_CMD_MODIFY_TASK.description: Edit the description of a queued task.

Command_CMD_REORDER_TASK.description: Reorder a pending task within its queue to a new zero-based position.

Command_CMD_RESTART_CANCELED_TASK.description: Transition a canceled task back to pending by taskId.

Command_CMD_REMOVE_TASK_PHASE.description: Remove a phase from a task after explicit operator confirmation.

Command_CMD_DELETE_QUEUE.description: Two-phase queue deletion (preview without confirmed, execute with confirmed: true).

Command_CMD_SAVE_QUEUE_SETTINGS.description: Persist workspace queue concurrency cap and default queue id.

Command_CMD_SET_QUEUE_FAILURE_POLICY.description: Set a queue-level halt-on-failure override or null to inherit workspace default.

Command_CMD_ATTEST_TASK_COMPLETED.description: Operator attests that a failed task completed externally.

Command_CMD_MOVE_TASK.description: Move a task across queues with an optional insertion position.

Command_CMD_RETRY_PHASE_NOW.description: Trigger an immediate retry for a delayed-retry phase on the addressed queue.

Command_CMD_PAUSE_PHASE.description: Pause the active phase on the addressed queue.

Command_CMD_RESUME_PHASE.description: Resume a paused phase on the addressed queue with an optional operator prompt.

Command_CMD_RESTART_PHASE.description: Restart a specific phase on the addressed queue.

Command_CMD_SKIP_PHASE.description: Skip a phase on a specific run and queue.

Command_CMD_DISABLE_PHASE.description: Disable a phase on the addressed queue.

Command_CMD_ENABLE_PHASE.description: Re-enable a disabled phase on the addressed queue.

Command_CMD_SET_PHASE_BREAKPOINT.description: Set a future-phase breakpoint on a specific run and queue.

Command_CMD_CLEAR_PHASE_BREAKPOINT.description: Clear a future-phase breakpoint on a specific run and queue.

Command_CMD_OPEN_AUDIT_LOG.description: Open the workspace audit log in VS Code.

Command_CMD_OPEN_DASHBOARD.description: Open the full Schegent dashboard webview panel.

Command_CMD_OPEN_VERBOSE_SETTING.description: Open VS Code Settings scoped to schegent.logging.verbose.

Command_CMD_OPEN_TRUST_SETTINGS.description: Open VS Code Settings scoped to the read-only schegent.trust.* keys.

Command_CMD_SET_CONFIRM_SUPPRESSION.description: Persist per-action confirmation suppression state in workspace memento.

Command_CMD_SAVE_MODELS.description: Persist the Model Catalog with optional import revision and mutation tag.

Command_CMD_SAVE_GENERAL_SETTINGS.description: Save a batch of unprefixed scalar schegent.* settings validated against KEY_SPECS downstream.

Command_CMD_PING_BACKEND.description: Probe connectivity and availability for a single supported backend.

Command_CMD_SET_UNCONTAINED_BACKEND_GRAN.description: Grant or revoke uncontained execution posture for a single supported backend.

Command_CMD_RERUN_FROM_HISTORY.description: Rerun a historical run by runId with optional force flag for legacy preview entries.

Command_CMD_OPEN_HISTORY_ITEM_DETAILS.description: Open detail view for a recorded history item by id.

Command_CMD_RESOLVE_AUDIT_POINTER.description: Resolve a completed run auditLogPointer to its audit records.

Command_CMD_RESOLVE_HISTORY_DESCRIPTION.description: Resolve a completed run stored description for replay.

Command_CMD_READ_FAILURE_RECORD.description: Read the newest failure record for a (queueId, taskId) row.

Command_CMD_OPEN_DECISION_RECORD.description: Open the decisions.md record for a blocked row.

Command_CMD_SAVE_DEFINITION_DRAFT.description: Save an authored draft body for one catalog definition.

Command_CMD_PUBLISH_DEFINITION.description: Publish the current draft of one catalog definition.

Command_CMD_RESTORE_DEFINITION_VERSION.description: Copy a historical published version back into a draft.

Command_CMD_DISCARD_DEFINITION_DRAFT.description: Discard an unpublished draft for one catalog definition.

Command_CMD_PUBLISH_PACKAGE.description: Commit a multi-layer imported catalog package.

Command_CMD_READ_DEFINITION_VERSION.description: Read a historical definition version body by (kind, id, versionId).

Command_CMD_EXPORT_PROCESS_YAML.description: Export a Phase, Workflow, or Model Catalog to a host-dialog YAML file (never carries a path).

Command_CMD_PREFLIGHT_PROCESS_YAML.description: Open host dialog to preflight an imported process YAML document (empty payload only).

Command_CMD_READ_PHASE_LOG.description: Read persisted phase log entries for a safe-path-segment tuple.

Command_CMD_START_PHASE_LOG_TAIL.description: Start a live phase log tail session for a concrete iteration.

Command_CMD_STOP_PHASE_LOG_TAIL.description: Stop an active live phase log tail session.

Command_CMD_ACK_PHASE_LOG_TAIL.description: Acknowledge a live phase log batch with credit, resync, or duplicate flags.

Command_CMD_READ_METRICS.description: Scan workspace audit/rollup metrics with optional archive inclusion and bounded runIds filter.

Command_CMD_READ_STORAGE_DETAILS.description: Read storage pressure summary and one paginated artifact inventory page.

Command_CMD_READ_USAGE_ACCOUNTING.description: Read one usage accounting page; query validation is delegated to the shared host validator.

Command_CMD_READ_REPORT.description: Run, page, drill down, cancel, list, or reproduce historical reports.

Command_CMD_MUTATE_REPORT.description: Export (via host dialog), save, or delete a saved report record.

Command_CMD_LAUNCH_PIPELINE.description: Compose, validate, freeze, and enqueue a Pipeline RunRequest.

Command_CMD_LAUNCH_WORKFLOW.description: Launch a connected Workflow run from a declared startNodeId.

Command_CMD_CONTINUE_WORKFLOW.description: Continue or apply a control operation to a connected Workflow run.

Command_CMD_READ_EXECUTION_VISIBILITY.description: Read attempt visibility details or runtime lane/telemetry posture.

Command_CMD_OPEN_CHANGE_REVIEW.description: Open, refresh, classify, page, close, or cancel an immutable candidate change review.

Command_CMD_DECIDE_PHASE_HANDOFF.description: Approve or edit a manual phase-to-phase context handoff revision.
